name: Hazards
describe: Water, the world's edge and hard falls: a player who falls in is out for a moment and comes back on reachable ground; hard landings can hurt
examples: fall in the sea and come back on your island
knocked off the edge of the world

water.description: Falling into the water (the world's sea, or its waterAt) takes a player out for a moment

waterDepth.description: How far under the water surface the feet go before it counts (m)

out.description: Leaving the world (past its edge, or falling below its floor) takes a player out for a moment

outMargin.description: Metres past the world's edge before it counts

floor.description: Height below which a body is out (null: 8 m under the lowest of the sea and the world)

protectSeconds.description: Seconds of protection after coming back (fair play)

fallDamage.description: Damage per m/s a landing is over fallSafe (0: falls never hurt); passed to the health mechanic

fallSafe.description: Fastest landing that does not hurt (m/s)

splashFx.description: A vfx preset where a player falls into the water (water-splash); unset: none

splashSound.description: A sound id for a fall into the water; unset: none

fallSound.description: A sound id when a player goes out (the edge, the floor); unset: none

backSound.description: A sound id when a player comes back; unset: none

toast.description: Tell the player who fell, in a toast

textWater.description: What the player who fell in the water reads

textOut.description: What the player who went out reads

templates.label: The world's edge takes players out

events.name: onFall
events.when: a player fell in the water or out of the world (by: whoever threw them last)

events.name: onBack
events.when: a player came back after a fall

host.how: the host watches every player and decides a fall; it tells every copy (the splash, the hold under water) and where the player comes back

bots: no bot code (the part watches every player, bots included)

lines: The kit HUD and the toast say a player fell; rules only score: hz.onFall(e => { if (e.by && e.by !== e.player) e.by.score += 3; }).
A player comes back on ground every seat can reach (the world's placement API), near their own seat, protected for protectSeconds.
With the knockback mechanic a thrown player's thrower is e.by for creditSeconds after the throw.

stub.worked: hz.onFall(e => { if (ctx.host && e.by && e.by !== e.player) e.by.score += 3; });
traps: onFall runs on the host only: score there, never on every copy
do not move a fallen player yourself: the part brings them back

signs: checked: gate C (measure 15) judges its sign of life (sample and judge in the implementation)
